title: Francisci Maurolyci Opera Mathematica: electronic edition of the mathematical works of Francesco Maurolico
author: Francesco Maurolico
institution: Dipartimento di Matematica, Università di Pisa (Maurolico research group)
notes: Critical edition, with variant readings from each manuscript or print witness, of the scientific works of Maurolico (1494-1575): Euclid, spherics, arithmetic, Archimedes, conics, music, optics, cosmography, mechanics, letters and methodological writings. The introduction says the full corpus is about 5,000 pages of manuscripts and prints and that works are added as they are ready; pages are frames-based HTML with PDF versions. Source-image sites need a login. Counts are not published, so texts and words are left out. The original Pisa address in the catalogue (www.dm.unipi.it/pages/maurolic, 2008 Wayback copy) now redirects to this one. Archived: pages last modified between April and July 2006.
